hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.js|*.ts|*.astro) npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; case "$f" in *.scss|*.css|*.astro) npx stylelint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; case "$f" in *.js|*.ts|*.astro|*.scss|*.css|*.json) npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; true; }
